title: The False Shield Hero
text: It’s been a while since Kou got a lecture from his Father.
“Bro! Aren’t you going to start selling food?”
Keel has come up with an idea for a street food business.
“Hmm… Since Gaelion seems to be able to breathe fire now, it’d be possible to turn the horse-drawn carriage into a food cart. But I’m not sure if that’s such a good idea…”
“I think we could sell stuff—even just skewered meat! I want a crepe!”
“I’m a little scared that ‘Saint of the Divine Bird’ might end up sounding like ‘Divine Bird Food Cart,’ though.”
“That’d sound like you’re cooking Filolial-sama!”

That would lead to a terrible misunderstanding. It’s true that some of Filolial-sama’s creatures are labeled as “meat” and disposed of—every time I see a Filolial-sama turned into meat, my heart breaks. And to make matters worse, if people were to think that my Father is selling them at his traveling stall, I simply couldn’t bear it.
“Gyaaah!”
Kou shrieks and trembles at the sound of that conversation.
“I absolutely oppose this! Look—Kou is terrified!”
“If Motoyasu-kun feels that strongly about it, maybe we should reconsider… Well, we’re not exactly struggling for money, so I guess it’s fine. I wonder if Kou’s been traumatized…”
“I thought it was a good idea, though…”
“It’s a hassle to cook while hiding your face, so I guess it can’t be helped.”

It’s quite a hassle, isn’t it? After all, whenever they go outside, they basically have to hide their appearance under a robe. It won’t be revealed until a little later that the Shield Hero is actually the Saint of the Divine Bird. As they were talking about this, they arrived at the village, but…
“Hahahahaha! Look! Hand over that money right now!”
“W-what are you doing?!”
“We’re the Shield Hero’s party! If you just hand over the money willingly, you might be able to avoid getting hurt.”
There was a guy threatening the villagers while saying things like that. That’s… probably an assassin from the Three Heroes Church posing as the Shield Hero, isn’t it?

He’s carrying a large shield, and his face has Japanese features. Since a Hero has been summoned in the past, perhaps he’s someone with that bloodline mixed in. Behind him is a Demi-Human slave who looks out of place. …He’s probably bound by a slave mark.
“What about that… what should we do, bro?”

“Hmm… It’d be easy to prove we’re the real deal, but whether we help him or abandon him, our infamy is bound to spread either way. I mean, why would someone committing crimes go out of their way to reveal their true identity…”

That’s true. Back then, my father wasn’t recognized as the Saint of the Divine Bird—the Shield Hero. Word did spread by word of mouth from Riyute Village that this Shield Hero wasn’t a villain, but apparently, it remained nothing more than hearsay.

The people didn’t truly begin to trust the Shield Hero until it was revealed—through the Three Heroes Church’s conspiracy—that my Father had kidnapped his Finacée, thereby proving that the Saint of the Divine Bird was indeed the Shield Hero. Even if I were to step forward now and prove I’m the real deal, it wouldn’t do anything to improve my Father’s reputation.

Even if he were captured, he’d probably claim he was ordered by the real Shield Hero to impersonate him. In fact, I remember him saying something like that when my future self defeated the imposter who was posing as my Father. There’s absolutely no benefit for my Father in this.
“Is the Shield Hero infamous, by any chance?”
When my Assistant asked my Father this, he nodded.
“Well, this is a human kingdom. Apparently, the Shield Hero—whom the Demi-Human kingdom worships—is considered something of an enemy here.”
“So, should we go defeat him?”
“Hmm… As Saints of the Divine Bird, it shouldn’t be a problem to defeat him.”
“Exactly.”
“Alright then, Sakura-chan and the others, I’ll leave it to you.”
“Got it!”
Sakura-chan, Yuki-chan, and Kou dashed out and charged toward the fool impersonating her Father.
“W-Who are you! I’m the Shield Hero! What are you—Ugh!”

Sakura-chan, leading the charge, slashed the impostor in a cross-cut with the swords she held in both hands. That alone sliced the shield into four pieces; Yuki-chan followed up with a heel drop, and Kou scattered the remaining opponents with his kicks.
“Ah! The Holy One of the Divine Bird!”
Keel watched the scene from the carriage with a look of frustration on his face.
“I… I was too slow… I still can’t keep up with Sakura-chan’s speed.”
“Piyo!”
Luna-chan was petting Keel’s head as if to comfort him.
“Grr! Don’t underestimate me! I am the Shield Hero!”

Oh, perhaps thanks to Yuki-chan going easy on him, the imposter posing as my Father has managed to get back on his feet. My Father isn’t that weak. I mean, is there really such a fool who would commit a crime while shouting out his true identity? At least we wouldn’t do something like that.
“The Shield Hero without a shield?”
The shield has already been cut into four pieces by Sakura-chan and is lying on the ground. He’s definitely an imposter. To begin with, the Four Holy Weapons are indestructible.
“Gau!”
Before we knew it, the assistant had gotten out of the carriage and was closing in from behind alongside a monster.
“Whoa! W-w-what—a dragon!?”
“Gaelion.”
“Gau!”
The assistant coldly declared to the imposter, whose face was contorted with fear.
“Tear out its windpipe!”
“Gau!”
Just as the monster, its jaws wide open, was about to strike…
“U, uwaaaaaaa! S-stop ittttttt!”
“Stop.”
“Gau!”

To be honest, I don’t particularly like this monster, but its resolve and expression show that it won’t hold back against anyone who opposes my Father. In that regard… I suppose I could acknowledge it.
“Are you really… the Shield Hero?”
“Y-yes!”
“Even though you don’t have a shield?”
“Ugh…”
The Assistant delivers this line as if it were torture, a broad grin spreading across her face.
“My monster loves liars. So, are you really the Shield Hero?”
The Assistant’s monster lets a drop of drool fall onto the imposter.
“Wyndia-chan, when did you learn to do something like that?”
“Wasn’t it the other day, when Big Bro scolded Kou for biting my tail?”
Kou flinched. That incident must have traumatized him. But don’t worry. Father was just teaching Kou a lesson for getting too cocky. If you’re a good boy, he’ll be kind to you in return.
“…Was that me imitating him?”
“Come to think of it, he might’ve been imitating the dragon’s father.”
“From what I’ve heard, the dragon’s father seemed to dote on him quite a bit, so I don’t think that’s it. Wait, I feel like I’m getting off track here.”

While my father and Keel were analyzing the situation from inside the carriage, the Assistant’s threats continued. No, he’s serious about that. Did his deep-seated contempt for humans just burst out somewhere?
“Gaelion.”
“Gau!”
The monster bit into the imposter’s arm. With a nasty cracking sound, blood began to flow.
“Gyaaaaaaaaaaah!”
“For someone who’s supposed to be the Shield Hero, you sure don’t have any Defense Power, do you? Hey, are you really the Shield Hero?”
“Gau Gau!”
“My monster says you’re a delicious liar, you know?”
“H-Hiiiiii! N-No, I’m not the Shield Hero! P-Please, just spare my life—”
“I see… Gaelion!”
With a thud, the monster struck the imposter hard in the stomach.
“Ugh—”
The imposter is slumped over, seemingly unconscious.
“So, this Shield Hero is an imposter, then.”
Muttering this under her breath, the assistant returned to the carriage. Sakura-chan and the others were left speechless.
“Gyaa! I’m scared of being dismembered…”
Kou, for his part, has even started trembling with fear. The assistant beckons her Father over.
“I think you should treat him right away.”
“Ah, thank you.”
Father put on his robe, stepped down from the carriage, and began treating the unconscious imposter.
“It seems this is an imposter posing as the Shield Hero. Even if it was to make him confess, that was going too far. Are you all okay?”
“As expected of the Holy One of the Divine Bird! To make someone impersonating the Shield Hero confess! We aren’t even a bit hurt!”
“I see… I’m glad to hear that. If possible, could you hand these guys over to the vigilante group?”
“Yes! Leave it to us! …But why did an imposter of the Shield Hero show up…?”
Muttering things like that, the unconscious imposter was led away by the villagers.
